explanations.explanation: In 'اِیْمَانُهُمْ', at the last letter (position 7 of 7), there is Meem Sakin (مْ). The next letter 'و' comes from 'وَلَا'. Since the next letter is neither Ba nor Meem, the rule is Izhar Shafawi (إظهار شفوي): pronounce Meem clearly, without ghunnah and without merging.
